name.description: This is the name of the scenario.

instructions.description: This is the script/instructions for the tester to follow during the simulation.

evaluations.description:
This is the structured output-based evaluation plan for the simulation.
Each item defines a structured output to extract and evaluate against an expected value.

hooks.description: Hooks to run on simulation lifecycle events

targetOverrides.description: Overrides to inject into the simulated target assistant or squad

path.description:
Optional folder path for organizing scenarios.
Supports up to 3 levels (e.g., "dept/feature/variant").
Set to null to remove from folder.
